title: Compare one-frame and four-frame PPO training at equal game exposure
doing: Prepare paired PPO training from checkpoint420 with unchanged entity-transformer and reward. Match actual game-frame budgets, as the user chose; record policy-decision and compute costs separately. Evaluate both resulting models under the same one-frame sampled controller. Freeze frame target, rollout/minibatch sizing, time-normalized discount handling, training seeds and held-out evaluation before launch.
expected: Training with one-frame decisions may improve Q1 beyond the immediate frozen-policy inference gain by learning under its own finer control. It may also plateau or regress. Equal game exposure gives the one-frame arm more decisions and more computation, so this comparison does not claim equal compute efficiency.
why: Separate learned adaptation to finer control from the already-observed inference-only frequency change. Match the physical experience budget and make optimizer cadence and discount horizon explicit to avoid attributing hidden recipe differences to control timing.
next_step: Wait for audited D8 confirmation; prepare and review the concrete equal-frame recipe and resource calibration before training.

evidence.label: Equal-game-frame training comparison preparation and remaining launch prerequisites
